summary: Skyline Builders Group Holding Ltd (SKBL), a Cayman Islands construction contractor, filed a 6-K disclosing a merger and reorganization. SKBL (target) agreed to merge with SKBL Merger Sub Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Cove Kaz Capital Group LLC, which will convert into a Delaware corporation (PubCo). Concurrently, KRLLC will contribute its interest in Kaz Critical Minerals LLP via AIFC NewCo to Cove Kaz. Each SKBL ordinary share converts into one Pubco Class A common share; no cash consideration, premium, or per-share price stated. The board recommended the transaction; no financial advisor named. The transaction resembles a reverse merger or business combination, not a conventional acquisition. Watch for regulatory approvals in Kazakhstan and Cayman Islands; risk-arb focuses on deal certainty and listing resulting PubCo.
